results.market_title: Will the National Rally group hold 10 French Senate seats after the 2026 election?
results.reasoning: RN currently holds only 3 Senate seats and has never had a Senate group (minimum 10 needed). Party leadership itself frames the goal as "doubling or tripling" its seats to "approach" (frôler) ten — aspirational language suggesting even RN's own optimistic internal target sits near, not comfortably above, the threshold. Municipal 2026 results reportedly boosted RN's local implantation (grand électeur base), with LR reportedly bracing to lose 3-5 seats to RN's push, which is a real tailwind, but France's indirect senatorial electoral system (dominated by mostly rural/small-commune grand électeurs) has historically been unfavorable to RN relative to its national vote share, making a clean breach of 10 seats and formal group registration by Oct 12, 2026 uncertain rather than likely.
results.key_findings: ["RN holds just 3 Senate seats currently (as of pre-2026 election), insufficient to form a group (Wikipedia FR)","RN campaign director Ludovic Pajot: party wants to 'double or triple' its senator count, i.e., 'frôler' (approach) ten seats (Public Sénat)","Post-March 2026 municipal elections, LR fears losing 3-5 Senate seats to RN's momentum (Public Sénat, dated late March 2026)","As of Sept 13, 2026 (2 weeks before the Sept 27 vote), no confirmed final seat count or group declaration exists yet","RN has never had a Senate group in its history; forming one would be a major symbolic and organizational milestone tied to Le Pen's 2027 presidential strategy"]

ledger.read: paper = the bot's own ledger (mid in, mid out, no fees). taker = same trades bought at the ask with taker fees: what real money would have made. makerOnFilled = the subset where a bid at the entry-time best bid got hit before the TTL, bought there with the maker rebate; compare with takerOnFilled/paperOnFilled on the same subset. Unfilled makers are missed trades, not losses.

xvenue.read: polyMoves = minutes where Polymarket's mid moved >= 3c; staleKalshi = of those, Kalshi's same-minute quote was still crossable after its 7.000000000000001% x p(1-p) taker fee (avgStaleEdgeC = cents of edge per share); kalshiSameMin/NextMin = Kalshi moved the same way that minute / the next; kalshiLeads = Kalshi moved first and Polymarket followed. A Kalshi lane is worth building only if staleRate x avgStaleEdgeC is meaningfully positive over many games. us* = the same for Polymarket US (taker 6.950000000000001% x p(1-p)); kUsCross = minutes where buying on one US-legal venue and selling on the other cleared both taker fees (the only fully legal arbitrage pair for a US operator).
